question: Does an ES-specific calendar-flow mechanism (turn-of-month: month-end / new-month cash inflows into S&P 500 index funds, pension rebalancing, 401k contributions) add independent return to T61-R1C when traded as a 2-MES module?
why_ES_specific: flows are benchmarked to the S&P 500 (ES), not ported from an MNQ rule; information = calendar (not price state), so it is neither C43 exposure timing nor an unconditional overnight carry (holds only across the TOM window)

primary_E67_TOM.entry: 09:31 open fill (grid j=0) of the LAST trading session of the month (td=-1)
primary_E67_TOM.exit: 16:15 close fill of the 3rd trading session of the new month (td=+3)
primary_E67_TOM.hold: overnight across the window, close-to-close MTM

gate: TEST65+ incremental gate (TEST65 prereg): all items incl. matched-beta excess (same year x vol tercile x bull, same holding length), SLIP4, +1 bar delay, plateau, regime / year share, folds, risk
prior_risk: well-known anomaly (possible decay post-publication); 2020 crash overlap; multi-day holds raise worst-day tail
